description: This file contains asynchronous test functions for the /health and /routes endpoints of a web service, utilizing pytest and aiohttp for HTTP requests and testing.

methods.name: health(session, call_key)
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a GET request to the /health endpoint, returning the JSON response if the status is 200.

methods.name: generate_key(session)
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a POST request to generate an API key with specified models, returning the JSON response if successful.

methods.name: test_health()
methods.description: Test to verify the /health endpoint returns a healthy response with status 200.

methods.name: test_health_readiness()
methods.description: Test to verify the /health/readiness endpoint returns expected JSON with status 200.

methods.name: test_health_liveliness()
methods.description: Test to verify the /health/liveliness endpoint returns a response with status 200.

methods.name: test_routes()
methods.description: Test to verify the /routes endpoint returns a response with status 200.
